title.narrative: FANN (Art in Arabic): Fostering Arts, Narratives, and New Perspectives for social cohesion

description.narrative: FANN (¿Art¿ in Arabic): Fostering Arts, Narratives, and New Perspectives for Social Cohesion, has been strategically designed to leverage art and cultural activities to promote social cohesion, mutual understanding, and democratic participation among Lebanon¿s diverse communities. It seeks to ensure that people in Lebanon benefit from representative democracy and from an influential civil society. FANN directly addresses the call¿s first Specific Objective,to enhance social cohesion in Lebanon, by focusing on cultural activities that bring together individuals from diverse backgrounds. Through cultural expression and artistic interaction, FANN will create opportunities for communities to connect on a human level, breaking down prejudices and fostering mutual respect. Thus, social cohesion will be enhanced and a shared identity fostered in the multifaceted crisis situation that Lebanon is currently facing, where social tensions are exacerbated by economic disparities, political instability, and the pressures of hosting a large refugee population.
